static_traits.name: Chen Yicheng
static_traits.occupation: Gap year, temporarily not yet attending college and without stable Work
static_traits.social_status: Feels left behind compared with friends, affecting relationships with friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar problems before; no prior psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to specifically describe emotions and automatic thoughts; high cooperation; speech often containing absolutist, catastrophizing and negating statements (e.g. 'I have already failed' 'have no other reason')

basic_info.main_problem: I feel overwhelmed because my friends have all made plans to go to college, while I am still uncertain and taking a gap year. This uncertainty makes me believe I will fail and will always depend on my parents.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these overwhelming feelings of failure and the comparing mind are affecting my mental health and self-esteem.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not worthy of being admitted
I will always depend on my parents, unable to be independent

special_situations.event: Seeing / learning that friends all have plans or application progress for university
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not entered college on time like my peers, it shows I am behind and a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to quickly make plans or distract myself with hobbies, but still repeatedly compares myself with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I have already fallen behind; I am a failure

special_situations.event: Every email check has not brought a reply from the Veterinarian school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the school has not replied, it means they do not care about me/I am not good enough, and I will ultimately not be admitted by any school
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently checking email and rehearsing the worst-case scenario in mind to seek certainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are not interested; I will never get into the Veterinarian school

special_situations.event: The application season begins, with frequent discussions of future plans around me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Having no set plans yet during the application season shows my future is already doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifying self-blame and Self-denial, finding it hard to commit to concrete planning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have already failed; it will stay this bad

special_situations.event: Thinking that I am taking a gap year and Lives with parents
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still live with my parents now and have no clear plans, I will always depend on my parents and be unable to be independent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering expectations by belittling myself, avoiding facing the Anxiety brought by uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always live with my parents; I will never become independent

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and accepted (admitted by the Veterinarian school, keeping equal status with peers), and realizing self-worth and independence
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected, worrying about being left behind by peers, being seen as 'not good enough' and losing worth and belonging
defense_goal: Reducing hope to avoid further setbacks and the pain of Being rejected through preemptive Self-deprecation and Anticipating the worst outcome

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes 'finding other explanations/evidence' to challenge negative beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing 'have no other possibilities, Silence equals Being rejected', understanding the lack of reply as a negation of self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a firm tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'have no other reason/this is the fact', giving minimal response to the counselor's alternative Interpretation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about comparisons with friends and experiences of falling behind
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating peers' and society's standards as the only valid judgment; if I have not met the standard yet, it equals failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using 'should/must'-style standardized language to emphasize self-Demands, in a self-blaming tone, ignoring individual differences and situational factors.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing the email still has no school reply
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Transforming the outside world's Silence into negation and attack on the self ('I am not good enough, I am not worthy')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-criticism and negative labels, lowering self-worth, reducing external verification and proactive communication.

manifestations: Describing 'already failed' 'seeing no hope', equating temporary Silence with long-term hopelessness
Self-worth strongly depends on external responses and admission results
outcomes: Decreased motivation, difficulty making future plans

manifestations: When comparing with friends, feels left behind, excluded from the peer track
Feeling especially uncomfortable and detached when discussing future plans
outcomes: Avoiding or reducing communication about the future

manifestations: Feeling Anxiety and burden about the choices and responsibilities after the gap year
Worries that a wrong choice will lead to long-term failure and dependence on parents
outcomes: Hesitation and procrastination, difficulty making action-oriented choices
Avoiding the Anxiety brought by uncertainty through Catastrophizing

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Internalizing peers' timelines as the sole standard: not yet enrolling on time = failure
Takes 'a reply = being valued' as an absolute rule

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and introspection, including excessive self-restriction and harshness, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not good enough' 'I have already failed')
Continuing to blame myself despite insufficient evidence, finding it hard to accept other Interpretations

contact_model.definition: The individual turns energy originally meant to be directed outward against the self, converting emotions or actions that should be directed outward into self-attack/Repression.
manifestations: Turning disappointment and dissatisfaction about the school's 'not yet replying' into self-blame and belittling the self
Reduces external communication and verification; more internal friction and self-criticism

exception_events.target_problem: When checking email and having received no school reply, usually immediately interpreting Silence as 'I am not good enough/will not be admitted', then falling into helplessness and despair, affecting daily life and sleep.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the first days after sending the email, he felt more hopeful and took proactive action (sending inquiry/application emails), and had not yet immediately fallen into the 'I have already failed' mindset.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different approach (proactively sending emails, taking action); different situation (not yet having experienced the long Silence loop and comparison stimuli); therefore hope and action were easier to maintain then.

positive_force: Able to take action proactively (once proactively emailed the school)
Has some capacity for self-observation and empathy (can give friends more balanced advice)
Willing to seek help and accept cognitive restructuring exercises
negative_force: Cognitive biases like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking and predicting the future
Fragile self-esteem, prone to self-blame and Self-denial
Low tolerance for uncertainty, jumping to conclusions at Silence

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated catastrophizing and Self-deprecation Automatic thoughts (feeling hopeless, believing 'already failed/not good enough')
antecedent: Checking email and not yet seeing a school reply
Hearing/participating in conversations about future plans
Seeing friends' college application progress or plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Against the background of social comparison and application Silence, Interpreting Silence and temporary lag as Being rejected and permanent failure; the core belief is 'I am not good enough / I am a failure'.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety brought by uncertainty (lowering expectations through preemptive negation and self-blame), and trying to gain a sense of control.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation, difficulty making concrete plans; daily routines and Sleep affected; relationships with friends damaged.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance and procrastination before and after application and planning tasks (difficulty concentrating and moving forward)
antecedent: When comparison with peers turns unfavorable
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about failure and Being rejected; the black-and-white standard of 'meeting the standard = worthy / not yet meeting the standard = failure' leading to action paralysis.
target_behavior.function: In the short term, avoiding the Anxiety and shame brought by failure and judgment.
target_behavior.consequence: Planning and application progress stalled, further reinforcing the belief of 'being left behind / being a failure'.
